user_story: As a user, I want to search for products on the product list page so that I can find specific items quickly. Acceptance criteria: 1. When I enter a valid product name in the search input with id 'search_product' and click the button with id 'submit_search', I should see relevant products listed. 2. If I submit the search without entering any text, the URL should not change and the product list should remain visible.
